# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_routes (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_routes` data source to list routes in the VRF routing table

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_routes" "example" {
  vrf = "vrf-123"
}

output "routing_table" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_routes.example.routes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `routes` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--routes))
- `vrf` (String) Filter by VRF ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Optional:

- `device_fqdn` (String) FQDN of the device reporting this route
- `distance` (Number) Administrative distance
- `metric` (Number) Route metric
- `network_service_config` (String) Network service config ID associated with this route
- `next_hop` (String) Next hop address
- `prefix` (String) Network prefix
- `protocol` (String) Routing protocol
- `received_at` (String) Timestamp when the route was received
- `vrf` (String) VRF ID
